questions.stem: What does the Gnome racial Eureka! do in Forever?
choices: makes non-periodic abilities 10% cheaper and stronger
questions.explanation: Eureka! is an 8 sec buff that makes non-periodic abilities 10% cheaper and stronger. +1% hit is Dwarf Artisan's Precision and +2% haste is Skyborne Wind-Blessed.

questions.stem: What does the Gnome racial Engineering Specialization do in Forever?
choices: cuts the failure and backfire rate of engineering devices by 20%
questions.explanation: In Forever Engineering Specialization no longer adds skill. It cuts the failure and backfire rate of engineering devices by 20%.

questions.stem: Which racial spells does a Gnome Priest unlock through class quests?
questions.explanation: Warcraft Tavern lists Confounding Flash and Contingency Plan for Gnomes. Desperate Prayer and Chastise are Dwarf, Divine Grace and Feedback Human.

questions.stem: Which Alliance racial for raiding Mages is an 8 sec buff that makes non-periodic abilities cheaper and stronger?
questions.explanation: That is Gnome Eureka!. Human Ruthless gives +1% crit and High Order Skyborne Wind-Blessed +2% haste.
